# The Agent Loop

Most useful agents aren’t single-shot. They plan, act, check results, and sometimes need more turns. This chapter teaches multi-turn patterns without turning your code into a brittle “agent script.”

## This Chapter Will Cover

- When you actually need a loop (and when you don’t)
- Safe loop shapes (max turns, explicit stage progression, deterministic exits)
- Logging with `Log.info/warn/error` so replays are legible
- Per-turn tool control (enable a dangerous tool only when the workflow is ready)
- Common failure modes: loops that never finish, tools called too early, “agent drift”

## How It Connects to the Running Example

We’ll keep the recap workflow mostly single-turn, but we’ll use a small loop to demonstrate how to iterate safely when the agent’s first draft isn’t good enough.
